# 10 · Data dictionary (gold)

[← 9 · Run it on Databricks](09-run-on-databricks.md) · Next: [11 · Data quality →](11-data-quality.md)

Generated from the contracts in [`contracts/gold/`](../contracts/gold/). These comments are what Genie reads to decide
which table answers a question and which column to use, so they follow two templates:

- **Table comment** = *what one row is* + coverage + *which questions it answers* + what it excludes + units.
- **Column comment** = *what it is in business words* + unit, currency and sign + allowed values or an example + *when to use it*.

### gold.dim_date

FreshCart fiscal calendar, one row per calendar day from FY2010 to FY2027. Use to convert dates to fiscal weeks, periods, quarters and years and to filter relative periods such as last week or year to date. Rolling flags are recomputed on every run relative to the as-of date of the pipeline.

Primary key: `calendar_date`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `calendar_date` | DATE | no | Calendar day. Join key for sales_date and snapshot_date on the facts. |
| `day_of_week_name` | STRING | yes | Monday to Sunday. FreshCart weeks run Sunday to Saturday. |
| `fiscal_year` | INT | yes | FreshCart fiscal year, named for the calendar year it starts in. FY2026 runs from Sunday 1 Feb 2026 to Saturday 30 Jan 2027. |
| `fiscal_quarter` | INT | yes | Fiscal quarter 1 to 4. Q1 starts in February. |
| `fiscal_period` | INT | yes | Fiscal month 1 to 12 on a 4-5-4 pattern. Period 1 starts in February. Use for any question about months. |
| `fiscal_period_name` | STRING | yes | Label such as P01 Feb. Use for display. |
| `fiscal_week` | INT | yes | Fiscal week of year, 1 to 52, or 53 in 53-week years such as FY2023. |
| `fiscal_week_start_date` | DATE | yes | Sunday that starts the fiscal week. |
| `fiscal_day_of_year` | INT | yes | Day number within the fiscal year (1 to 364 or 371). The same number means the same weekday last year; use for like-for-like comparisons. |
| `is_last_completed_fiscal_week` | BOOLEAN | yes | TRUE for the 7 days of the most recent fully completed fiscal week. Use for last week. |
| `is_last_4_completed_fiscal_weeks` | BOOLEAN | yes | TRUE for the 28 days of the four most recent completed fiscal weeks. Use for last 4 weeks. |
| `is_current_fiscal_quarter` | BOOLEAN | yes | TRUE for all days of the fiscal quarter that contains yesterday. |
| `is_fiscal_ytd` | BOOLEAN | yes | TRUE from the first day of the current fiscal year up to and including yesterday. |
| `is_prior_fiscal_ytd` | BOOLEAN | yes | TRUE for the same fiscal days in the previous fiscal year. Compare with is_fiscal_ytd for year to date versus last year. |

### gold.dim_store

One row per FreshCart store or Dark Store with current attributes, plus an UNKNOWN member. Use to filter or group sales and stock by store, format, city, state, region or country, and for store lists such as openings. Attribute history is in silver.store_history.

Primary key: `store_id`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `store_id` | STRING | no | FreshCart store number without leading zeros, for example 1042. Join key to the facts. |
| `store_name` | STRING | no | Trading name, for example FreshCart Boston Seaport. Use when a question names a store. |
| `store_format` | STRING | no | One of: Supercenter, Neighborhood Market, Express, Dark Store. Dark Stores fulfil online orders only. |
| `city` | STRING | yes | City where the store is located. |
| `state_province` | STRING | yes | US state or Canadian province, full name, for example Massachusetts. |
| `country` | STRING | yes | United States or Canada. |
| `region` | STRING | no | FreshCart operating region (management hierarchy, not census region). One of: Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West, Canada. |
| `open_date` | DATE | yes | Date the store first traded. |
| `open_fiscal_year` | INT | yes | Fiscal year in which the store first traded. Use for questions about store openings by year. |
| `close_date` | DATE | yes | Date the store stopped trading, if closed. |
| `store_status` | STRING | no | Open or Closed on the as-of date of the pipeline run. |
| `selling_area_sqft` | INT | yes | Selling floor area in square feet, excluding back room. Zero for Dark Stores. Use for sales per square foot. |
| `comparable_from_fiscal_year` | INT | yes | First fiscal year in which the store counts as comparable (like-for-like): the first year after one full fiscal year of trading. NULL for Dark Stores, which are never comparable. |
| `is_comparable_store_current_fy` | BOOLEAN | no | TRUE if the store is open and comparable in the current fiscal year. |

### gold.dim_product

One row per product (SKU) with the current merchandise hierarchy, plus an UNKNOWN member. Use to filter or group by department, category, subcategory, brand or private label.

Primary key: `product_id`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | STRING | no | FreshCart item number without leading zeros. Join key to the facts. |
| `product_name` | STRING | no | Shelf description, for example Crunchy Sea Salt Chips 200g. |
| `brand` | STRING | yes | Brand name. FreshCart own-brand products use FreshCart or FreshCart Select. |
| `department` | STRING | no | Top level of the merchandise hierarchy: Produce, Bakery, Meat and Seafood, Deli, Dairy and Eggs, Grocery, Household. |
| `category` | STRING | no | Second level, for example Snacks, Beverages, Cleaning. |
| `subcategory` | STRING | no | Third level, for example Chips and Crisps, Cookies and Biscuits. |
| `unit_of_measure` | STRING | no | Each or Kilogram. Kilogram items are weighed at the till; their quantities are weights. |
| `is_private_label` | BOOLEAN | no | TRUE for FreshCart own-brand products (own brand, store brand). |
| `product_status` | STRING | no | Active or Discontinued. |

### gold.dim_customer

One row per loyalty customer, identified only by a pseudonymous id, plus the ANONYMOUS member for baskets without a loyalty card. Contains no names, emails or dates of birth. Use to group sales by loyalty tier, age band or home store.

Primary key: `customer_id`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | STRING | no | Pseudonymous loyalty customer id (SHA-256 of the card number), or ANONYMOUS. |
| `loyalty_tier` | STRING | no | Gold, Silver or Bronze; Anonymous for non-members; Unknown for new members not yet in the CRM extract. |
| `age_band` | STRING | yes | Age band derived from date of birth, for example 35-44. The date of birth itself is never stored here. |
| `home_store_id` | STRING | yes | Store the member chose as home store. |
| `enrollment_date` | DATE | yes | Date the member joined the loyalty programme. |
| `is_placeholder` | BOOLEAN | no | TRUE for a late-arriving member seen in sales before the CRM extract caught up. Details are filled in when the CRM row arrives. |

### gold.dim_promotion

One row per promotion, plus NO_PROMO for lines sold at full price. Use to group sales by promotion or promotion mechanic.

Primary key: `promotion_id`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `promotion_id` | STRING | no | Promotion code, for example BG26W33, or NO_PROMO. |
| `promotion_name` | STRING | no | Promotion description shown in marketing, for example Snack Attack - Buy one get one free. |
| `promotion_mechanic` | STRING | no | Buy One Get One, Percent Off, Multi-buy, Loyalty Price, or No Promotion. |
| `start_date` | DATE | yes | First day the promotion runs. |
| `end_date` | DATE | yes | Last day the promotion runs. |

### gold.fct_sales_line

Sales fact. One row per sold or returned item line on a FreshCart receipt or online order (voids, cancelled orders and training transactions excluded), since FY2025. Answers questions about sales, revenue, units, baskets, margin, returns, promotions and loyalty by day, store and product. All amounts are USD and exclude sales tax unless the column name says local.

Primary key: `sales_line_id`  
Foreign keys: `sales_date` → `dim_date.calendar_date`; `store_id` → `dim_store.store_id`; `product_id` → `dim_product.product_id`; `customer_id` → `dim_customer.customer_id`; `promotion_id` → `dim_promotion.promotion_id`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sales_line_id` | STRING | no | Unique id of the line: channel, store or order, receipt and line number. |
| `transaction_id` | STRING | no | Receipt or online order id. COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) gives transactions (baskets). |
| `sales_date` | DATE | no | Business date of the sale in store local time. Join to dim_date.calendar_date for fiscal periods. |
| `store_id` | STRING | no | Selling store; for online orders, the fulfilling store or Dark Store. |
| `product_id` | STRING | no | Product sold or returned. UNKNOWN if the item was not in the product master. |
| `customer_id` | STRING | no | Pseudonymous loyalty customer id, or ANONYMOUS when no card was scanned. |
| `promotion_id` | STRING | no | Promotion applied to the line, or NO_PROMO. |
| `region` | STRING | no | Copy of dim_store.region used only for row-level security. Use dim_store.region for analysis. |
| `sales_channel` | STRING | no | In-store or Online. |
| `line_type` | STRING | no | Sale or Return. |
| `quantity_units` | DECIMAL(12,3) | no | Units sold in selling units, not cases. Negative for returns so SUM gives net units. Kilograms for weighed items. |
| `gross_sales_amount_usd` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Value at shelf price before discounts, excluding tax, USD. Negative for returns. |
| `discount_amount_usd` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Promotional and loyalty discounts, USD, as a positive number that reduces sales. |
| `net_sales_amount_usd` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Gross sales minus discounts, excluding tax, USD. Negative for returns. The company definition of sales and revenue. |
| `cost_of_goods_usd` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Standard cost of the units on the day of sale, USD. Negative for returns. Zero when the product is UNKNOWN. |
| `gross_margin_usd` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Net sales minus cost of goods, USD. |
| `net_sales_amount_local` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Net sales in the store local currency. Only for statutory local reporting. |
| `currency_code` | STRING | no | ISO code of the local currency: USD or CAD. |
| `is_promo_sale` | BOOLEAN | no | TRUE when a promotion was applied to the line. |
| `is_loyalty_sale` | BOOLEAN | no | TRUE when a loyalty card was scanned on the transaction. |
| `_source_ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | yes | Pipeline audit column: when the source file landed in bronze. Not for analysis. |

### gold.fct_inventory_daily

Daily stock position. One row per store, ranged product and day, from nightly snapshots covering the last 13 fiscal weeks. Use for stock on hand, stock value and out-of-stock questions. Stock levels must not be summed across days.

Primary key: `snapshot_date, store_id, product_id`  
Foreign keys: `snapshot_date` → `dim_date.calendar_date`; `store_id` → `dim_store.store_id`; `product_id` → `dim_product.product_id`

| column | type | nullable | comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snapshot_date` | DATE | no | Day of the close-of-business stock count. Join to dim_date.calendar_date. |
| `store_id` | STRING | no | Store holding the stock. |
| `product_id` | STRING | no | Product in stock. |
| `region` | STRING | no | Copy of dim_store.region used only for row-level security. |
| `on_hand_units` | DECIMAL(12,3) | no | Sellable units in stock at close of business. Semi-additive: can be summed across stores and products but never across days. |
| `on_hand_value_usd` | DECIMAL(18,2) | no | Value of on-hand stock at standard cost, USD. Semi-additive like on_hand_units. |
| `is_out_of_stock` | BOOLEAN | no | TRUE when a ranged, active product had zero sellable stock at close of business. |
